column1: # E-D4-03's extra public captures (D4, P4-4-S2): the protocols of R6.7's
# insecure list and the platform's own sessions that MANIFEST.tsv and GT-PCAP
# do not hold. Wireshark's sample captures. Not vendored, as their
# redistribution terms are not stated; fetched at run time and checked.
